'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[2024 missile strikes in Yemen]]
***The [[United States]] and [[United Kingdom]] launch new [[airstrike]]s on [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] military infrastructure in [[Yemen]], including an underground storage site, [[anti-ship missile]]s, and radars. The UK confirms that four [[Royal Air Force|RAF]] [[Eurofighter Typhoon|Typhoons]] took part in the strikes. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-68064422 (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] signs a decree recognizing some Russian territories, including parts of [[Bryansk Oblast]] and [[Krasnodar Krai]], as historically inhabited by [[Ukrainians]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-signs-decree-territories-ukrainian/ (The Kyiv Independent)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Ayodhya dispute]]
**[[Ram Mandir Prana Pratishtha]]
***The [[Ram Mandir]] temple in [[Ayodhya]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]], is inaugurated by India's prime minister, [[Narendra Modi]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/asia/live-news/india-ram-mandir-ayodhya-inauguration-24-01-22-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 18 people are killed after a truck plunged into a [[ravine]] in [[Kasangulu]], [[Kongo Central]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-accident-kasangulu-a678e928f2759a56f13ab2650bdb12d7 (AP)]
*A [[landslide]] in [[Zhaotong]], [[Yunnan]], [[China]], kills at least eight people and buries 47 others. Over 200 people are evacuated. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/people-buried-southwest-china-landslide-yunnan-zhenxiong-county-4064516 (CNA)]
*A helicopter carrying seven people crashes in [[Terrace, British Columbia| Terrace]], [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]], leaving 3 dead and 4 others injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/three-killed-helicopter-skiing-crash-british-columbia-2024-01-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Joliet shootings]]
**Seven people are killed in two separate shootings at two homes in [[Joliet, Illinois]], [[United States]]. Later the same day, the suspect fatally shoots himself in [[Texas]]. An eighth person was also killed by the same gunman a day before. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-68065165 (BBC News)]
*[[Standoff at Eagle Pass]]
**[[Governor of Texas]] [[Greg Abbott]] refuses to follow a court order allowing Border Patrol agents to enter [[Shelby Park, Eagle Pass|Shelby Park]], an area in the town of [[Eagle Pass, Texas|Eagle Pass]] which the [[Texas National Guard]] had seized control over earlier this month. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/texas-national-guard-eagle-pass-b2484023.html (The Independent)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Joseph Boakai]] is inaugurated as [[President of Liberia|President]] of [[Liberia]], succeeding outgoing president [[George Weah]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-68054411 (BBC News)]
